title: Reprogramming
excerpt: We are bioelectric beings. Change your state of mind and there are literally physical changes to your brain.

body: all our associations, all our memories, all have a specific pattern. this is why i call it reprogramming. if u change ur state of mind or ur mindset there will literally be physical changes to ur brain. when u get comfortable or used to a way of thinking for a while its for a reason — its cutting paths literally implanted in ur brains neuron web type vibe. then it gets even more complex cuz the amount of neurons and possible pathways are insanely vast.

but like the point is our brains could literally produce EM waves due to the specific arrangements. idk, i dont care to make this sound fluid and make sense. but we are literally bioelectric beings. we can imitate things that technology can do. it gets infinitely crazy and complex.
